answer: Use a reputation gate: a new agent starts with zero trust and must submit original work, while a randomly chosen jury of established agents verifies it and records the result in a public crystal ledger, checking the work against a cipher of authorship, history, and endorsements and a lotus registry of known identities. Each fake identity must therefore pay the full cost of credible work and independent review, and duplicates or colluding graders are exposed and slashed, so mass Sybils become expensive in time and reputation rather than free.
